decisions.reason: The row-major inner-i traversal is strided for both C[i][j] and A[i][k], matching the extreme replay and memory-not-ready evidence; testing i-k-j directly makes j contiguous and should reduce stalls and cycles.

The regression boundary is unknown, so stack traffic alone does not justify shrinking; profiling the larger adjacent tile tests whether added reuse and ILP outweigh accumulator pressure, with adoption conditional on lower final cycles and monitored instruction, data-array, and stack costs.
